svg.title: BreedFrame AI and ML inference paths
svg.desc: Detailed text-controller and image-classifier pipelines, followed by deterministic reporting and presentation.
svg.text: Two pretrained models, separate inputs, and deterministic evidence handling. Inference only; no training or fine-tuning.
Persist the actual tool result → refresh evidence → choose again
B / VISION: PIXELS TO BREED RANKINGS
60 s classifier call limit · persistent worker
Parent sends file path via Pipe
C / RECORDED EVIDENCE TO THE UI
resolved label, no quality flags or unresolved disagreement.
Cross-photo votes preserve each view; raw scores are never averaged.
Latest current-photo result → top match + model-score percentage.
Source photo / region / event + tentative wording + detailed limits.
Browser and Markdown export share this summary; the stored
outcome can remain inconclusive. Scores are not breed probabilities.
Model choices are bounded by code. No dog detector, automatic region selection, or probability calibration is implemented.
